entries.zh: 讨取；讨要、索取（如讨债、讨亲娶妻）
entries.en: to take; to demand, ask for, claim (e.g. collect a debt, take a wife)

entries.zh: 执、持；用手拿取（如执笔等）
entries.en: to grasp, hold in the hand; to take up (as a pen, etc.)
entries.notes: 音写栏 'quim v.f. chip' 中 v.f. 为无法解读的缩记，仅 chip 与汉字執相合。

entries.en: to take away, carry; to fetch, go get
to seize by force, snatch away
entries.notes: 音写栏夹入西语 por fuerza，其前 'hun çai' 一段未能解读。

entries.en: to hold up with both hands, carry in both hands
entries.notes: 汉字棒疑为'捧'之同音借字，义取双手捧持。

entries.zh: 强占、侵占（如占夺王国土地）；篡夺
entries.en: to seize by force, occupy (as kingdoms and lands); to usurp
entries.notes: 西语 ut reynos hirras 处有 [疑]（hirras/rras），hirras 疑为 tierras（土地）之讹。

entries.en: to pick up with the tips of the fingers, take a pinch
entries.notes: 音写 'chê bó ià' 后半未能解读，撮取义依汉字撮与西语栏。

entries.en: to pinch, twist up with the fingertips (gloss cites a knot/lump, cf. Tagalog gúntod)
entries.notes: 西语例词 pumes 有 [疑]（pumes/lumes）；音写夹注 con gunto 为他加禄语 gúntod（小结、疙瘩）。

entries.zh: 查、查究；审查（西语专指受理官员任满司法审查 residencia）
entries.en: to examine, investigate; (colonial admin.) to hold the residencia, review an official's term
to snatch, grab violently
entries.notes: 音写 'chîo / tù' 第二形 tù 未能对应，抢夺义依汉字搶与西语栏。

entries.en: to take by snatching; to seize and annex
to usurp, seize (a throne, kingdom) by force
to take, get; to collect (payments, debts)
to take (medicine)
to take the cool/fresh air, cool off outdoors

entries.zh: 清凉、清爽（感到凉爽畅快）
entries.en: to feel cool and refreshed; cool, refreshing
entries.notes: 音写 seng liâng 疑即'清凉'，汉字爽亦清凉畅快之义。

entries.zh: 认教父、教母（西语栏义）；汉字栏作'喫'（吃/受），两栏不合，释义存疑
entries.en: to take as godfather/godmother (per Spanish column); Chinese column 喫 'to eat' does not match — gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 西语栏（认教父母）与汉字/音写栏（喫 guiê，吃）语义不合，无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（汉字捻：捻搓、捏捻；残存西语疑为'凭记忆记取'）
entries.en: original damaged, gloss uncertain; 捻 'to pinch, twist' — surviving Spanish reads 'tomar de memoria' (to memorize?)
entries.notes: 西语栏标注 [残]，仅能依汉字捻与残存西语立说，存疑。

entries.zh: 量尺寸；尺寸（依西语栏；汉字栏'此'与音写 pŏy 与此义不合）
entries.en: to take a measurement; a measure (per the Spanish column; Chinese column '此' and reading pŏy do not match)
entries.notes: 汉字栏'此'与西语'量尺寸、尺寸'义不合，音写 pŏy 未能对应，仅西语栏自明，存疑。

entries.zh: 掳掠、强掳（掳掠；亦可单用掠）
entries.en: to seize, carry off by force; to plunder (擄掠, or 掠 alone)
to plunder, seize by force
to take by force, annex forcibly (強併)
